abjad.translation: [网络] 辅音音素文字；辅音型的拼音文字；辅音字母

abject.definition:
s. of the most contemptible kind
s. most unfortunate or miserable
s. showing utter resignation or hopelessness
s. showing humiliation or submissiveness
abject.translation:
a. 绝望无助的, 可怜的, 糟透的, 卑鄙的, 自卑的
[法] 卑鄙的, 卑下的, 可怜的

abjection.definition: n a low or downcast state
abjection.translation: n. 卑鄙, 落魄, 抛弃, 驱逐

abjective.translation: a. 不幸的,令人沮丧的

abjectly.definition: r. in a hopeless resigned manner
abjectly.translation: adv. (境况)低贱, 凄惨, 很可怜, 可鄙, 不自爱, 卑鄙, 卑下

abjectness.definition:
n. The state of being abject; abasement; meanness;
   servility.

abjudge.definition: v. t. To take away by judicial decision.
abjudge.translation: vt. 放弃(对案件的)裁定, 不予判决, 消(案), 取消

abjudicate.definition: v. t. To reject by judicial sentence; also, to abjudge.

abjugate.translation:
abjugate (third-person singular simple present abjugates, present participle abjugating, simple past and past participle abjugated)
(obsolete, transitive) To unyoke; set free; uncouple.

abjuration.definition: n a disavowal or taking back of a previous assertion
abjuration.translation:
n. 发誓断绝, 公开放弃
[法] 宣誓放弃

abjuration of the realm.translation: [法] 弃国宣誓, 出逃宣誓

abjure.definition: v. formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure
abjure.translation:
vt. 发誓断绝, 公开放弃
[法] 誓绝, 弃绝, 公开放弃

abjured.translation: vt. 发誓放弃；公开放弃；避免

abjurer.translation: n. 发誓弃绝者, 正式放弃者

abjures.definition: v formally reject or disavow a formerly held belief, usually under pressure
abjures.translation: v. 发誓放弃( abjure的第三人称单数 ); 郑重放弃（意见）; 宣布撤回（声明等）; 避免

abjuring.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Abjure
abjuring.translation: vt. 发誓放弃；公开放弃；避免
